subject: Brightside go-live readiness & staffing — staging plan and milestone owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kwan <alice.k@brightsidehealth.com>, Tom Rogers <tom@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Brightside go-live readiness — draft MAP and milestones

Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Brightside_MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestone windows, proposed owners, and a suggested week-by-week staging plan toward a target go-live of 2026-11-30. High-level notes:

- Security/compliance gate: SOC evidence + network allowlist review (target: complete by 2026-11-10)
- SSO + SCIM setup: Redwood to provide SAML metadata; Brightside to confirm IdP settings (target: 2026-11-09)
- Data ingestion & validation: initial sample transfer, validation, and reconciliation (target: 2026-11-17)
- UAT window: 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-27 (aiming for staff availability week)
- Go-live: 2026-11-30 (soft launch for 10% of traffic; ramp week of 2026-12-06)

Actions we need from you this week to stay on schedule:
1) Procurement sign-off timeline (procurement@brightsidehealth.com) — we need a firm commit by 2026-11-03 to meet the procurement calendar.
2) Designate Brightside owners for SSO, Data Transfer, and UAT sign-off (names + emails).
3) Any compliance evidence that is time-sensitive (e.g., internal SOC packages) — upload to the shared Drive link or send to monica_patel@redwood.ai.

I've cc'd Marissa (CS lead) and Monica (Implementation PM) who will coordinate tasks and weekly checkpoints. If the 2026-11-30 target is optimistic for your team, let us know — we can propose a phased go-live that reduces scope to the core ingestion path first.

Attaching: Brightside_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft)

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

---
From: Alice Kwan <alice.k@brightsidehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rogers <tom@brightsidehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightsidehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightside go-live readiness — draft MAP and milestones

Karthik — thanks for the clear plan and the spreadsheet. A few immediate constraints from our side:

- Procurement deadline: our internal procurement committee meets on 2026-11-20; legal wants final SOW and T&Cs by 2026-11-12 to get on the agenda.
- Security review: infra/security need artifacts by 2026-11-05 to complete our internal checklist before the external SOC review.
- Owners: I can own UAT sign-off (alice.k@brightsidehealth.com). Tom will own data transfer coordination. We still need someone from our identity team for SSO/SCIM — looping them in separately.

We appreciate the phased go-live alternative if timelines slip. Procurement is copying a checklist (Procurement_Checklist_Brightside.xlsx) — attaching for reference.

If you can confirm the SSO task owner on the Redwood side and whether you can provide a SAML test IdP by 2026-11-04, that will help us align.

Thanks,
Alice Kwan
Director, Product & Integrations
Brightside Health

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kwan <alice.k@brightsidehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightside go-live readiness — draft MAP and milestones

Alice / team — I updated the MAP with explicit owners and a compressed timeline where possible. Attachment: implementation_roster.docx (roster + on-call rotations). Key updates below (copying the map rows into the email for visibility):

- SSO / SCIM (owner: Rishi Malhotra, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai) — Redwood to share SAML metadata and a step-by-step checklist by 2026-11-02. Brightside identity team to confirm IdP settings by 2026-11-04.
- Security evidence & network allowlist (owner: Monica Patel, monica_patel@redwood.ai) — deliverables: transport encryption summary, data flow diagram, sample logs. Deadline to Brightside: 2026-11-05.
- Data ingestion (owner: Tom Rogers [Brightside]) — transfer test and validation to be completed by 2026-11-17. Redwood point: Sean Gallagher (sean_gallagher@redwood.ai) will lead ingestion support, weekly syncs on Tuesdays 10am PT.
- UAT & acceptance (owner: Alice Kwan) — UAT cycle 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-27, with final acceptance sign-off requested by 2026-11-29 to allow for a 2026-11-30 soft launch.

If procurement/legal need redlines earlier, we can surface standard SOW clauses that typically resolve quickly.

Next steps:
- Karthik: confirm we can deliver SAML test metadata by 11/02.
- Alice: confirm procurement's ability to get docs to legal by 11/12.
- Monica & Sean: schedule first data-run test for week of 11/09.

Thanks — sending a short roster and escalation contact list as the attachment.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kwan <alice.k@brightsidehealth.com>, Tom Rogers <tom@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Brightside go-live readiness — draft MAP and milestones

Team — summarizing decisions and the commit calendar so we have a single source of truth. If Brightside confirms the procurement commit by EOD 2026-11-03 we remain on track for the 2026-11-30 soft launch. Otherwise, we should plan for the phased approach. Agreed milestone timeline below (concrete dates):

Milestone timeline (finalized):
- 2026-11-02: Redwood provides SAML metadata + SSO checklist (owner: Rishi Malhotra)
- 2026-11-05: Security evidence & network allowlist delivered to Brightside (owner: Monica Patel)
- 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-13: SSO test window and fix iterations (owner: Brightside identity / Rishi support)
- 2026-11-17: Data ingestion validation complete (owner: Tom Rogers / Sean Gallagher)
- 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-27: UAT window (owner: Alice Kwan)
- 2026-11-29: Final acceptance sign-off requested (owner: Alice Kwan)
- 2026-11-30: Soft go-live (10% traffic) with ramp plan the following week

Action items (who/what/when):
- Rishi: deliver SAML metadata by 2026-11-02 and be available for IdP handoff testing on 2026-11-09.
- Monica: upload SOC evidence summary and network allowlist items to Drive by 2026-11-05.
- Sean: schedule ingestion run for 2026-11-10 and coordinate the 11/17 validation.
- Marissa: run weekly checkpoint meetings (Tuesdays 10am PT), invite Brightside stakeholders.
- Alice / Procurement: confirm legal timing and whether the SOW version in Drive can be signed by 2026-11-12 (legal input) / 2026-11-20 (procurement meeting).

Fallback / de-scope option: If legal/procurement or security gating causes a delay beyond 2026-11-12, we will pursue a phased roll that launches the ingestion pipeline only for internal testing customers and postpone higher-risk integrations to December. That plan is already drafted in the map (sheet: phased_go_live).

Please reply with a short "ack / confirm" and any schedule conflicts. I'll circulate an updated MAP and the implementation roster on Monday morning.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

---
From: Alice Kwan <alice.k@brightsidehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rogers <tom@brightsidehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightsidehealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightside go-live readiness — draft MAP and milestones

Karthik / team — ack and confirm. Procurement has reviewed the SOW and will fast-track to legal; legal expects to provide final comments by 2026-11-11. We will aim to have signed SOW to you by 2026-11-12, but in the event of minor redlines procurement will escalate to ensure placement on the 2026-11-20 committee.

SSO: our identity owner confirmed availability for 2026-11-09 testing.
Data ingestion: Tom and Sean will coordinate the first transfer on 2026-11-10.
UAT: I will run the acceptance checklist during 11/23–11/27 and expect to provide sign-off by 11/29 if no critical issues are found.

Attaching: SOW_signed_Brightside_20261103.pdf (Procurement placeholder — final signature will be applied pending legal clearance).

Thanks for the clear timeline and the fallback plan. Confirming brightside will proceed on the schedule and we will surface any blockers immediately in the Tues check-ins.

Best regards,
Alice Kwan
Director, Product & Integrations
Brightside Health
